mapper.sql: select id, tech_code, tech_name, tech_group, tech_desc, tech_version, product_seq, product_id, relation_type, tech_type, tech_pattern, class_code, class_name, tenant_code, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date, active_flag from micro_technology
mapper.select:
SELECT mp.id, mp.product_seq AS itemSeq , mp.product_code AS itemCode , mp.product_name AS itemName , IF(mt.id IS NULL, 0, 1 ) AS standard FROM micro_product mp LEFT JOIN micro_technology mt ON mp.tenant_code = mt.tenant_code AND mp.product_seq = mt.product_seq AND mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.tech_type='STANDARD' WHERE 1 = 1
AND (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR mp.product_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%'))
order by standard DESC,mp.id DESC

SELECT mt.id, mt.product_seq, mt.product_id, mp.product_name, mp.product_code FROM micro_technology mt LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON mt.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mt.product_id = mp.id WHERE mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.tech_type = 'STANDARD' AND mt.relation_type = 'PRODUCT'

SELECT CONCAT_WS('&', mpc.process_id, mpc.parent_process_id, mpc.process_seq, mpc.parent_process_seq, IF(mpc.is_last_process is NULL, '1', mpc.is_last_process)) AS chainStr FROM micro_process_chain mpc WHERE mpc.active_flag = '1' and mpc.tech_id = #{id}

select distinct mt.id from micro_technology mt where mt.relation_type = 'PRODUCT' AND mt.active_flag = '1'
AND mt.tech_type=#{techType}
AND (mt.product_id,mt.product_seq) in
(#{item.productId},#{item.productSeq})

SELECT t.id as product_id, t.product_code, t.product_seq, t.product_name, mws.operate_process_seq as process_seq, IF(mws.pre_process_seq IS NULL OR mws.pre_process_seq = '', '0', mws.pre_process_seq) as parent_process_seq FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN (SELECT tenant_code, mp.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.id, mp.product_name FROM micro_product mp WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT mt.product_id FROM micro_technology mt WHERE mt.product_id = mp.id AND mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.tech_type = 'STANDARD' AND mt.relation_type = 'PRODUCT' )) AS t ON mws.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND mws.product_seq = t.product_seq WHERE mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_type = '1'

SELECT mpc.id FROM micro_technology mt INNER JOIN micro_process_chain ch ON mt.tenant_code = ch.tenant_code AND mt.id = ch.tech_id AND ch.active_flag = '1' LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON ch.process_id = mpc.id WHERE mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.product_seq = #{productSeq}
AND ( mpc.process_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR mpc.process_code like concat('%', #{key}, '%') )

SELECT mp.process_id as processId, mp.process_seq as processSeq, mpc.process_name as processName, mpc.process_code as processCode, mp.is_last_process as isLastProcess FROM micro_process_chain mp LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mp.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND mp.process_id = mpc.id WHERE mp.tech_id = #{id} order by mp.id

SELECT mpc.process_seq AS operateProcessSeq, mpc.process_name AS operateProcessName, mpc.process_code AS operateProcessCode, mpc2.process_seq AS preProcessSeq, mpc2.process_name AS preProcessName, mpc2.process_code AS preProcessCode FROM micro_process_common mpc JOIN (SELECT mp.process_id, mp.process_seq, mp.parent_process_id, mp.parent_process_seq, mp.tenant_code FROM micro_process_chain mp JOIN micro_technology mt ON mp.tenant_code = mt.tenant_code AND mp.tech_id = mt.id JOIN micro_product mpt ON mt.product_id = mpt.id AND mt.tenant_code = mpt.tenant_code WHERE mpt.product_code = #{productCode}) AS t ON mpc.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND mpc.id = t.process_id LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc2 ON mpc2.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND mpc2.id = t.parent_process_id
